title: Ancient precision buildings in Peru, Lebanon and Egypt built by another civilization

tellings.quote: the buildings in Peru or in Lebanon, in Egypt, the pyramids, they built it with such precision.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a man introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 as the president of a Russian republic who says aliens took him in 1997, points to ancient buildings in Peru, Lebanon and Egypt, including the pyramids. He says they were built with such precision that another civilization must have made them, which would mean someone beyond the ancient people we know was at work.
